edits.new:
LAST_VERIFY="$VERIFY_JSON"

  if [[ ! -s "$VERIFY_JSON" ]]; then
    echo "FEHLER: Verifier hat keinen Report erzeugt."
    exit 43
  fi

  if [[ $VERIFY_RC -ne 0 ]]; then
    SYNTAX_BLOCKERS="$(python3 - "$VERIFY_JSON" <<'PY'
import json, sys
obj=json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
print(sum(1 for item in obj.get('blockers', []) if item.get('code') == 'SYNTAX_CHECK_FAILED'))
PY
)"

    if [[ "$SYNTAX_BLOCKERS" != "0" ]]; then
      echo
      echo "===== DETERMINISTISCHER SYNTAX-ROLLBACK ====="
      python3 -m model_runtime.rollback_syntax_failures \
        --repo "$VERIFY_DIR" \
        --base-ref "$VERIFY_BASE_COMMIT" \
        --handoff "$HANDOFF_JSON" \
        --verifier "$VERIFY_JSON" \
        --output "$SYNTAX_ROLLBACK_JSON"

      ROLLBACK_CHANGED="$(python3 - "$SYNTAX_ROLLBACK_JSON" <<'PY'
import json, sys
obj=json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
print('1' if obj.get('changed') else '0')
PY
)"

      if [[ "$ROLLBACK_CHANGED" == "1" ]]; then
        echo "[PIPELINE] Syntax-defekte Ziel-Datei wurde auf den nächsten gültigen Vorgänger zurückgesetzt; Verifier läuft erneut."
        set +e
        python3 -m model_runtime.deterministic_verifier \
          --repo "$VERIFY_DIR" \
          --base-ref "$VERIFY_BASE_COMMIT" \
          --handoff "$HANDOFF_JSON" \
          --output "$VERIFY_JSON" \
          --diff-output "$DIFF_FILE"
        VERIFY_RC=$?
        set -e
      fi
    fi
  fi

  if [[ $VERIFY_RC -ne 0 ]]; then
